row.proto: void *Game_PhysicsObjects_LoadResource(void *loader, void *a2, void *a3, const void *chunks, uint64_t chunk_count)
row.notes: Loader for the per-track physics objects resource (the barrier/tyre-wall prop systems), slot 7 of the vtable at 0x145a8f5e8 (cell 0x145a8f620, its only reference; next to the strings tecpro, cDeformableRubberLateral, cDeformableTyreWallLateral, PhysicsModule). Runs at track load before the bodies exist. chunks = array of 0x20-byte records (+0 data, +8 size, +0x10 u32 tag), chunk_count of them; it takes the last chunk tagged 'syst' (0x74737973). a2 and a3 are not read. Allocates a 0x30-byte container through the loader's allocator [loader+8] vt+0x18 (vtable 0x145a8f580; +0x18..+0x28 vector of 0x28-byte system entries), reads the chunk with a byte reader (vtable 0x145899750, big-endian swap when its flag != 1): version u32 must be 0x20000, then the system count; per system: +0 name, +8 body count with a 0xd0-byte body array at +0x10, +0x18 joint count with a 0x60-byte joint array at +0x20; a body whose name (+0x98) contains tecpro and whose u32 type field reads 1 gets 2. Constraint/body templates are matched by name against the template library [loader+0x10] (vector<Template *> +0x38..+0x40, name at template+8, compare 0x14535d850). Returns the container, or null after destroying it (vt+8) and freeing it (allocator vt+0x38) when a read fails.
